title: How To Price Merch So You Never Sell At A Loss
desc: The DIGITVL Stores AI suggests merch prices above a safe floor. You confirm every price before anything goes live.

sentences.text: Most artists guess their merch prices.
DIGITVL Stores looks at what each product costs to make and ship.
Printing and shipping costs are already counted in.
Then it suggests a price above a safe floor, so you don't sell at a loss.
You can move the price up or down, and you confirm every one.
Nothing goes live until you say yes.
Your brand, your prices, no surprises.
Fair prices for you, and for your fans.
